snippet.title: The Sims 3 Nintendo DS Trailer
snippet.description: The Sims 3 is coming to the Nintendo DS!  It's everything you love about The Sims 3, right in your pocket.  Create unique Sims, give them personalities and control them with Karma Powers.  You've never had control like this with your Sims on DS before.
